info.name: Autonomous AP APIs Chart of Accounts Unit of Measures API

items.docs: Creates a new unit of measure in AppZen. Returns a uuid for this unit of measure. When there already exists a unit of measure (with the same uom_code), then the operation is an update (in this case, the `status` in the response will be `UPDATED`).

params.name: uuid
params.description: Globally unique identifier for an uploaded document

items.docs: Returns the details of a unit of measure by uuid

params.name: uom-code
params.description: Customer specific unit of measure code

items.docs: Returns the details of a unit of measure matching the uom-code
